description: Saves a component to the person's favorites on systra.tools, so it shows up on every device and in list_favorites. Use it when the user asks to save, bookmark or remember a component for later. Pass the exact name from search_components or list_components. Only adds; removing works with the heart on the website. Needs a linked Systra Tools account; a free account is enough.

name.description: Component name as listed by search_components, e.g. 'PricingTrioBand'.

title: Save a favorite
